narratives.body: Yahoo Sports reports that the Chicago Bears are announcing a move to honor Mike Ditka during the Thursday Night Football game against the New England Patriots. The Bears are also honoring Ditka on Thursday night, a topic covered by multiple outlets including Yahoo Sports and NBC 5 Chicago.
narratives.headline: Chicago Bears: honoring Mike Ditka

narratives.body: Yahoo Sports, NFL.com, and other sources report that the New England Patriots and Chicago Bears are set to play Week 7 of the NFL season in a Thursday Night Football matchup. Various outlets discuss the inactives, weather conditions, and how to watch the game between the two teams.
narratives.headline: Chicago Bears: Patriots vs. Bears matchup

narratives.body: Yahoo Sports and Pats Pulpit discuss the New England Patriots' inactives ahead of the game, noting that Christian Gonzalez is good to go despite a newly announced illness. Other reports mention that the Patriots have ruled out five players and highlight Mike Vrabel's potential to end a 27-year streak.
narratives.headline: New England Patriots: inactives and game predictions
